summary: POSCO Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing preliminary third-quarter 2026 earnings for its subsidiary POSCO, prepared on a separate K-IFRS basis and not yet finalized by the independent auditors. Revenue was KRW 9.96 trillion, up 5.8% quarter over quarter and 13.2% year over year; operating profit KRW 0.46 trillion rose 66.1% sequentially but fell 22.1% year over year; net profit KRW 0.01 trillion collapsed 98.1% year over year on weaker pre-tax results. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
